description: Production process manager for Node.js applications
cmd_start_or_reload: Start or gracefully reload JSON file
cmd_pid: Return pid of app name or all
cmd_start_or_graceful_reload: Start or gracefully reload JSON file
cmd_scale: Scale up/down a process in cluster mode
cmd_delete: Stop and delete a process from pm2 process list
cmd_send_signal: Send a system signal to the target process
cmd_ping: Ping pm2 daemon - if not up it will launch it
cmd_update: Update in-memory PM2 with local PM2
cmd_install: Install or update a module and run it forever
cmd_module_update: Update a module and run it forever
cmd_module_generate: Generate a sample module in current folder
cmd_publish: Publish the module you are currently on
cmd_set: Set the specified config key value
cmd_link: Link with the pm2 monitoring dashboard
cmd_unlink: Unlink with the pm2 monitoring dashboard
cmd_dump: Dump all processes for resurrecting them later
cmd_attach: Attach stdin/stdout to application identified by pm_id
cmd_describe: Describe all parameters of a process
cmd_env: List all environment variables of a process id
cmd_jlist: List all processes in JSON format
cmd_prettylist: Print json in a prettified JSON
cmd_dashboard: Launch dashboard with monitoring and logs
cmd_logs: Stream logs file. Default stream all logs
cmd_pull: Updates repository for a given app
cmd_forward: Updates repository to the next commit for a given app
cmd_backward: Downgrades repository to the previous commit for a given app
cmd_deep_update: Performs a deep update of PM2
cmd_serve: Serve a directory over http via port
opt_name: Set a name for the process in the process list
opt_mini_list: Display a compacted list without formatting
opt_interpreter: Set a specific interpreter to use for executing app, default: node
opt_interpreter_args: Set arguments to pass to the interpreter (alias of --node-args)
opt_node_args: Space delimited arguments to pass to node
opt_log: Specify log file which gathers both stdout and stderr
opt_filter_env: Filter out outgoing global values that contain provided strings
opt_log_type: Specify log output style (raw by default, json optional)
opt_log_date_format: Add custom prefix timestamp to logs
opt_env: Specify which set of environment variables from ecosystem file must be injected
opt_update_env: Force an update of the environment with restart/reload
opt_instances: Launch number instances (for networked app, load balanced)
opt_shutdown_with_message: Shutdown an application with process.send('shutdown') instead of process.kill(pid, SIGINT)
opt_kill_timeout: Delay before sending final SIGKILL signal to process
opt_max_memory_restart: Restart the app if an amount of memory is exceeded (in bytes)
opt_restart_delay: Specify a delay between restarts (in milliseconds)
opt_exp_backoff_restart_delay: Specify a delay between restarts (in milliseconds)
opt_execute_command: Execute a program using fork system
opt_max_restarts: Only restart the script COUNT times
opt_user: Define user when generating startup script
opt_uid: Run target script with uid rights
opt_gid: Run target script with gid rights
opt_cwd: Run target script from path cwd
opt_hp: Define home path when generating startup script
opt_wait_ip: Override systemd script to wait for full internet connectivity to launch pm2
opt_service_name: Define service name when generating startup script
opt_cron: Restart a running process based on a cron pattern
opt_no_daemon: Run pm2 daemon in the foreground if it doesn't exist already
opt_only: With json declaration, allow to only act on one application
opt_wait_ready: Ask pm2 to wait for ready event from your app
opt_merge_logs: Merge logs from different instances but keep error and out separated
opt_ignore_watch: List of paths to ignore (name or regex)
opt_watch_delay: Specify a restart delay after changing files (--watch-delay 4 (in sec) or 4000ms)
opt_no_vizion: Start an app without vizion feature (versioning control)
opt_no_autostart: Add an app without automatic start
opt_no_autorestart: Start an app without automatic restart
opt_stop_exit_codes: Specify a list of exit codes that should skip automatic restart
opt_no_treekill: Only kill the main process, not detached children
opt_sort: Sort process according to field's name
opt_start_daemon: Run container in Daemon mode (debug purposes)
opt_start_dist: With --container; change local Dockerfile to containerize all files in current directory
opt_start_image_name: With --dist; set the exported image name
opt_start_node_version: With --container, set a specific major Node.js version
opt_install_install: Run yarn install before starting module
opt_install_v1: Install module in v1 manner (do not use it)
opt_install_safe: Keep module backup, if new module fail = restore with previous
opt_plus_info_node: Set url info node for on-premise pm2 plus
opt_dump_force: Force deletion of dump file, even if empty
opt_logs_lines: Output the last N lines, instead of the last 15 by default
opt_logs_nostream: Print logs without launching the log stream
opt_serve_spa: Always serving index.html on inexistant sub path
opt_serve_monitor: Frontend app monitoring (auto integrate snippet on html files)
